mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.admin_login_name AS adminLoginName, u.nickname, u.avatar_object_key AS avatarObjectKey, r.code AS role, u.status, u.onboarding_completed AS onboardingCompleted, u.must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, u.auth_version AS authVersion FROM users u JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id AND r.is_active = 1 WHERE u.id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = #{status}, auth_version = auth_version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId}
